thread:
anita: Quick sync — planning a pricing update that hits hosted + dedicated next quarter. Need a short ownership map for all implementation deps: metering events, billing calc, quota enforcement, and contract constraints. Who can own what? TL;DR milestones: design done by 04/05, implementation started 04/10, smoke by 04/25, rollout 05/05.

jun: I can take metering schema + event wiring. Question: do we need a new `pricing_tier` field or a separate invoice key?

samir: +1 for `pricing_tier` on events. We should add `pricing_tier` and `price_effective_at`. That avoids ambiguous retroactive billing. Example event:```json
{"customer_id": "C123","usage_units": 1200,"pricing_tier": "pro-v2","price_effective_at": "2026-05-05T00:00:00Z"}```Will need a migration for queued events and our kafka consumer to read new fields. Estimate: 2 weeks work (core + tests). :gear:

lina: I can own billing calc changes (billing-service). Need clear semantics for rounding, prorates, and trial overrides. Do we plan per-day prorate or immediate full-tier billing? Also quota changes: if quota decreases, do we cap or notify?

anita: Good Qs. Product wants daily prorate for tier changes (so customers billed for portion of billing cycle). For quota decreases, plan is to notify + soft-limit for 30 days before hard enforcement (to avoid breaking integrations). Need legal check on notices.

contracts-bot: Contract flag: standard T&Cs require 60 days notice for pricing increases if "pricing protection" clause present. Some enterprise contracts carve out custom terms. @robert please confirm on any outstanding negotiated protections.

robert: Confirmed — two customers have negotiated 90-day price locks in their MSA; one has explicit price-protection clause. We need to produce a list of affected accounts by 04/06. Also watch for clause that blocks automated prorate adjustments without consent.

jun: Noted. I'll add `contract_flags` enrichment in metering so we can tag events for those accounts (cheap initial filter).

samir: For implementation plan:
- step 1: add `pricing_tier` + `price_effective_at` to event schema (jun)
- step 2: consumer bump to handle new fields & migration logic (samir)
- step 3: billing calc changes + prorate logic (lina)
- step 4: quota service soft-limit + notify (eng-sre)
- step 5: contracts owner list output & legal signoff (robert)

anita: Owners + deadlines I propose: jun (metering schema) by 04/03, samir (consumer + tests) by 04/17, lina (billing calc) by 04/20, eng-sre (quota enforcement + notices) by 04/22, robert (contracts list + review) by 04/06. If anyone needs to swap dates ping here.

jun: I can do 04/03 for schema but will need a small follow-up window for test infra. Marking as `owner:jun` and adding an initial PR ping.

lina: 04/20 works but will need a one-week overlap with samir for integration testing. Please add me to the metering PRs.

samir: Will coordinate. I'll drop a PR with migration notes and a small `--dry-run` flag for billing so we can validate numbers in staging. :mag:

robert: I'll export the contracts list from CRM by 04/05 and flag impacted accounts. If any account requires manual consent, we should create a customer success workflow.

anita: Thanks all. Action items: @jun schema PR by 04/03, @robert contracts export by 04/05, @samir migration PR + staging dry-run by 04/17, @lina billing PR by 04/20, eng-sre to draft notification cadence by 04/22. I'll assemble a short runbook for rollout (canary regions + rollback). Ping me if you hit blockers. :thumbsup:

metering-bot: Reminder: new schema fields require data-platform schema registry update. Submit via https://schemas.internal.redwood/requests #schema-reqs.

jun: Got it, submitting request now.

lina: One more ask — can we add a test vector for a grandfathered customer with 90-day lock? want to ensure we don't override billing.

robert: I'll provide sample account IDs.

anita: Perfect. Will convert this to a short checklist in the project board. Thanks — closing thread for now, reopen if new blockers appear. :white_check_mark:
